10.source_text: The children of Israel were driven, by famine into Egypt. After centuries had rolled away, the Egyptians began to oppress and enslave them. God raised up a deliverer in Moses. The Egyptians despised and rejected him. By signs and by wonders were demonstrated the consequences of disobedience — the fire of pestilenco was kindled, and plagues raged among tho rebellious ; armed with full authority…
